BiblicalUsage: The land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together, for their substance was great, and all the people answered together, and said, all that the Lord hath spoken we will do.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe together is the word that breaks and binds: Abram and Lot could not dwell together for their substance, and Israel answered together at the mount, and the same word carries the parting and the promise.
